keywords: is my site visible to ai agents

find agent-ready APIs and tools for a task
discover MCP servers to add to an agent
monitor site agent signals for regressions
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a search index of agent-readable sites, reporting 5,800 sites indexed on the page (the listing text mentions 8,000+ MCP servers and tools) with an average score of 39. Each site is scored 0–100 across seven signals: llms.txt, ai-plugin, OpenAPI, API, AI bots, Schema.org and MCP. The site can be queried in the browser, via a REST search endpoint, or as an MCP server at nothumansearch.ai/mcp, which exposes search_agents, get_site_details, get_stats and submit_site tools. The listings also mention a verify_mcp live JSON-RPC probe tool and an optional weekly email for signal regressions.
